name: LlamaParse Managed Parser
mechanism: Provides managed document parsing with efficient and agentic modes, including chart-oriented extraction and structured Markdown or JSON outputs.
use_when: Complex charts or irregular documents justify an agentic managed path
Low operational burden matters more than on-premise control
avoid_when: Documents cannot leave the approved environment
High-volume variable API cost or provider dependency is unacceptable
expected_effects: Selective higher-effort parsing for charts and hard pages
failure_modes: Rate limits or outages block ingestion
required_evals: API latency and cost per page
